content.text: Digital creators in regions with limited payment options face significant challenges when [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/setting-up-nowpayments-digital-store-everything-you-need-20|COREMERCH guide to setting]]-up-nowpayments-digital-store-complete-infrastructure-20|How to]] up online stores. Stripe and PayPal are often unavailable, forcing creators to seek alternative solutions. COREMERCH provides robust infrastructure that empowers you to build a [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payment-gateways-digital-products-explained-digital-creators-15|crypto]] store using Cloudflare Pages, eliminating reliance on conventional payment systems. This guide will walk you through the essential steps to create a fully operational digital store without traditional payment barriers.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Building on platforms like Cloudflare Pages provides a resilient foundation for your digital storefront. Unlike traditional payment processors that can block access based on geographic restrictions, this stack leverages decentralized payment systems. By using NOWPayments, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with minimal fees and no KYC requirements. This ensures that you maintain full control over your transactions, allowing you to operate freely in an environment where conventional solutions have failed.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deployment, gather the necessary tools and resources. You will need a GitHub account to host your static site on GitHub Pages, along with familiarity with Google Apps Script for backend logic. Additionally, create an account with NOWPayments to facilitate crypto transactions. Prepare your digital products, as you'll load them onto the platform during the setup process. Having these components in place will streamline the deployment and ensure a smoother launch.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Configure your payment and delivery pipeline systematically. Start by setting up your GitHub Pages site for hosting. Next, integrate Google Apps Script to handle backend logic and order processing. Afterward, connect your NOWPayments account to process transactions automatically. Ensure that you configure webhook notifications correctly, so you receive alerts on payment confirmations. Finally, test your file delivery system to guarantee customers receive their products immediately after payment.
Own your infrastructure outright without reliance on third-party platforms.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

After testing your setup, it's time to go live. Announce your store's launch through social media channels and your existing networks. Monitor your site closely as the first transactions come in. Dealing with crypto means being vigilant; ensure that your payment confirmations come through without issues. Use data analytics to track user behaviors and sales patterns to optimize the performance of your store continually. This proactive approach will solidify your online presence.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your infrastructure is live and running smoothly, consider scaling up. You can add more digital products to your store without worrying about platform restrictions. Engage customers through email marketing campaigns and optimize your site using analytics. If you're looking for an even more powerful setup, consider the Edge Commerce Stack offered by COREMERCH, which includes advanced features and additional support for scaling your operations effectively.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

The setup sequence matters because each component depends on the previous one being correctly configured. Start with NOWPayments: create your account, configure wallet addresses for each coin you want to accept, generate the API key, and note the IPN secret key you will set. Then configure the backend: in Stack 01, deploy the Google Apps Script Web App and note its URL; in Stack 02, deploy the Cloudflare Worker and note its URL. Set that URL as the webhook endpoint in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Then configure the storefront. Then run a real mainnet test — send actual crypto to your configured wallet address, confirm NOWPayments detects it, confirm the webhook fires, and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link.
Accept a wide range of cryptocurrencies with minimal transaction fees.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Creators at the store setup stage comparing Stack 01 and Stack 02 are typically choosing between building it themselves with the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 — which covers both stacks in complete detail with full source code — or having COREMERCH deploy the complete Edge Stack under their accounts with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Both result in the same ownership structure: your GitHub or Cloudflare account, your Supabase database, your NOWPayments account, your wallet, your store. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Create a GitHub account for hosting your site. 2. Set up a Cloudflare account for additional performance. 3. Prepare your digital products for upload. 4. Integrate Google Apps Script for backend functionality. 5. Register with NOWPayments to manage crypto transactions. 6. Deploy your GitHub Pages site. 7. Test payment processing with NOWPayments. 8. Launch your store publicly and promote it across social media.
Frequently Asked Questions
How long does it take to set up Stack 01?
Stack 01 can be deployed in 4-6 hours, following the Sovereign Blueprint. This rapid setup allows you to start selling your digital products quickly while maintaining control over the entire process.
What are the key differences between Stack 01 and Stack 02?

Stack 01 utilizes GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, while Stack 02 incorporates Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase for a more robust infrastructure. Stack 02 is end-to-end tested and deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?

Yes, both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages are suitable for hosting a digital product store. They provide reliable hosting solutions with the added benefit of serving your products directly to customers.
What payment methods can I use with this setup?
This setup allows you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies through NOWPayments, ensuring you can cater to a global audience without the limitations of traditional payment processors.
Is there ongoing support after deploying the infrastructure?
Upon deploying the Edge Commerce Stack, you receive 30-day support to address any questions or issues as you get your store up and running successfully.
